# context plugin: project knowledge

## Architecture
- **Memory freshness: content-hash ✓/⚠/✗, not commit count**: Memories anchored to code store content hash of that region. Freshness mark: ✓ (hash unchanged since check), ⚠ (hash changed—verify before trust), ✗ (file or symbol not found). Committing verified work (already checked) does not flag memory stale; only real content changes trigger ⚠. Agents told to treat memory as claims to verify, not facts. _(why: Commit-count freshness flags verified work as stale; content-hash freshness is accurate. Reduces noise and false verification churn.)_ · `## Knowledge@docs/FAQ.md:138, plugin/src/pack.mjs:200` `m-401ae7`
- **Session naming: auto from first prompt, compressor spec title on save**: Session title auto-derived from user's first message (short first line). On save, compressor replaces with spec title: verb + object + outcome, ≤12 words, specific identifiers verbatim (e.g., 'Add per-user login rate limiter in src/auth.js'). User can override with #uac name <title>, uac name <title> --session <n>, or dashboard rename button. _(why: Auto title helps; spec title on save makes session list scannable. Generic titles like 'Continue work on X' don't distinguish which did what.)_ · `plugin/src/pack.mjs:140` `m-16147d`
- **Hook context injection: no LLM call needed for session start**: UAC hook (not an LLM) injects context into chat at session start or into first prompt. Context includes: project knowledge, session cards to continue from, other active branches, messages. Save instruction is plain text (says 'spawn uac-compressor' on Claude or 'call uac_digest, then uac_save' on other tools). For tools without hooks, paste PROTOCOL.md into agent rules. If no LLM ever saves, UAC builds automatic card from events (no LLM used). _(why: Hook does heavy lifting; LLM only reviews and ranks. Automatic card is fallback. Other tools can work without save instruction (slower, but no loss).)_ · `plugin/src/hook.mjs, How does another LLM know@docs/FAQ.md:13` `m-482410`
- **Phantom sessions: empty, zero-prompt sessions auto-hidden and purged**: A phantom session is created by VS Code on panel open/reload (SessionStart) but receives no prompts (user resumes old conversation instead). Zero prompts, zero events, no card, no title: phantom. These are hidden from lists and dashboards, not numbered, not returned by list/sessions (unless --all), deleted at SessionEnd, purged at the next start once ended or older than 30 min. If a phantom is still open (process running), its first prompt re-creates it normally. Precompact checkpoints are not written when nothing was recorded, preventing stale empty cards from being injected as "Continuing from #1". · `plugin/src/store.mjs:45, plugin/src/hook.mjs, U1@docs/PLAN-v4.md:10` `m-75ce73`
- **Task status lifecycle: status field (done/active/archived) with `uac_update` support**: Tasks (type: 'task') now have a `status` field: `active` (default, shown in "Open tasks"), `done` (resolved, hidden from lists), `archived` (closed without resolve). `uac_update` takes `status` parameter to transition. Compressor emits op `done` for resolved tasks. The `status` field is independent of body content, so a task that was "Add feature X" can be updated to status `done` and remain in history without changing its body. Dashboard filters by status; export includes done tasks in history section. · `CREATE TABLE@plugin/src/db.mjs:18, plugin/src/store.mjs, Tasks can't be closed@docs/PLAN-v4.md:21` `m-bfa20f`
- **Bootstrap context grouped by type and scope with type-first rendering**: The `uac_bootstrap` tool injects context grouped: Must not violate · Decisions · Warnings · Lessons · Architecture · Facts · Open tasks · Preferences (yours, all projects). Branch items tagged `[branch x]`. Within each group, items are sorted by score (high to low). Knowledge items are marked by scope: `user` (applies everywhere) vs `project` (project-specific). The same grouping logic used in `.context/PROJECT.md` export is applied to live bootstrap text, so the working LLM sees the same structured context every session. Accordion UI in dashboard (one group open) mirrors this structure. · `Must not violate@plugin/src/pack.mjs:175, plugin/src/hook.mjs, Type/scope invisible in bootstrap@docs/PLAN-v4.md:20` `m-2ae802`

## Decisions

### Session continuation: continue vs resume token cost `m-e3f9f8`
- **Decision:** ADR: resume (claude --resume) sends entire conversation (often 50–200K tokens, cheap only if prompt cache warm ~1h); UAC approach starts new session + #uac continue <n> to load session card (~2K tokens) + project knowledge. Continuation is default for same branch unless user specifies #uac fresh or #uac deep.
- **Why:** Long conversation replay expensive; card-based continuation cheaper and predictable for agents on same or different tools.
- **Code:** `## Resuming a session@docs/FAQ.md:114`
- **Status:** accepted (at e252e89)

### Auto-accept policy: memories ≥0.7 confidence auto-accepted `m-3b6e06`
- **Decision:** ADR: Compressor subagent reviews memories against diff and existing knowledge. Items with confidence ≥0.7 and no conflict auto-accepted immediately (records model, time, reviewer); only conflicts and uncertain items (<0.7) wait for user in dashboard/CLI/tool. Every acceptance tracked: auto-policy / compressor / user-dashboard / user-cli / user-tool.
- **Why:** Reduces review friction while maintaining oversight for uncertain items; auto-policy enables fast iteration without losing control.
- **Code:** `## Knowledge@docs/FAQ.md:129`
- **Status:** accepted (at e252e89)

### Tiers removed: replaced with session cards + #uac deep/fresh `m-0a7558`
- **Decision:** ADR: Removed "Minimal ~1k, Relevant ~4k, Deep ~10k, Fork, None" menu. Now every session loads: (1) must-not-violate constraints, (2) short project knowledge with ✓/⚠/✗, (3) continuing-from session cards, (4) other branches + messages. Default ~2K tokens. User can request #uac deep (~6K tokens) or #uac fresh (knowledge only, no prior session state). No half-baked context goes to LLM.
- **Why:** Menu was confusing; size numbers meaningless without context. Session cards are clearer control surface; deep/fresh are explicit user intents.
- **Code:** `## Starting and loading@docs/FAQ.md:34`
- **Status:** accepted (at e252e89)

### #uac at message start in Claude Code: use 'uac: ' prefix instead `m-0dbe36`
- **Decision:** Claude Code intercepts messages starting with # as its own memory shortcut; UAC never sees them. In Claude Code, write uac: save, uac: name ..., uac: rollup, etc. at message start. #uac ... on a later line still works. Outside Claude Code (Gemini, Cursor, etc.), #uac ... at line start works normally.
- **Why:** Claude Code's # intercept happens before hook; avoiding it requires prefix change only in Claude Code.
- **Code:** `In Claude Code, write@README.md:35`
- **Status:** accepted (at e252e89)

### Session merge and rollup as first-class UI operations `m-339064`
- **Decision:** Merge (uac merge 3 4 --into 2, or dashboard multi-select): moves sessions 3, 4 into session 2; all events/cards/memories move; emptied sessions removed; target gets combined automatic card; next save writes LLM card. Rollup (uac rollup --all, or #uac rollup): compresses many sessions into one new session with one card; originals hidden (not lost, see with --all flag or dashboard toggle). Use case: consolidate parallel exploratory work.
- **Why:** Merge consolidates related sessions; rollup compresses exploration into summary. Both leave audit trail (hidden sessions stay findable).
- **Code:** `plugin/src/cli.mjs, docs/FAQ.md:100`
- **Status:** accepted (at e252e89)

### Compressor agent is namespaced: universal-agent-context:uac-compressor with explicit `model: haiku` `m-626d75`
- **Decision:** ADR: The plugin's compressor subagent is namespaced `universal-agent-context:uac-compressor` (not bare `uac-compressor`), with explicit `model: "haiku"` in agent rules. If a host cannot find the namespaced name, it falls back to a general-purpose agent, which still saves correctly because `uac_digest` returns a self-contained recipe (no git needed). The namespace prevents confusion with other tools' agents and ensures intended model runs on first save.
- **Why:** Earlier sessions: Stop hook said bare `uac-compressor`, which didn't exist, so the system fell back to default model without compressor instructions. Live testing found compressor failed on first invocation with wrong model and wrong agent prompt. Namespace solves the lookup correctly.
- **Code:** `You are the UAC compressor@plugin/agents/uac-compressor.md:1, plugin/src/hook.mjs`
- **Status:** accepted (at 8eb6774)

## Constraints
- **Node.js 22.13+ required for node:sqlite built-in**: UAC uses node:sqlite (built into Node.js 22.13+). No npm packages for database. Check with `uac doctor`. If SQLite locked, hooks spool to ~/.uac/spool.jsonl and import on next DB open. If FTS5 missing, search falls back to LIKE. _(why: No external deps; built-in is simpler and available in environment. Fallbacks handle edge cases (locked DB, missing FTS5).)_ · `Does SQLite really work@docs/FAQ.md:176` `m-e369de`
- **Hook timeout: 30 seconds; database spool if locked**: SessionStart and Stop hooks timeout after 30 seconds. If database is locked at hook time, hook writes events to ~/.uac/spool.jsonl; they import on next DB open. If FTS5 full-text search is missing, search falls back to LIKE queries. Hook errors logged to ~/.uac/hook-errors.log. _(why: 30s timeout prevents session hang; spool prevents event loss on DB contention; fallbacks ensure graceful degradation.)_ · `timeout@plugin/hooks/hooks.json:10` `m-b246db`

## Requirements
- **Session continuity: new session loads latest chapter on same branch; chapters replace previous_card**: New session on same branch auto-loads the latest chapter (not previous_card—chapters replace the single-card model). Chapters are permanent: each save creates a new chapter with its own checkpoint and event range; all prior chapters stay in the database as history. User can override: #uac continue <n> to load specific chapters, #uac fresh for knowledge-only, #uac deep for more knowledge (~6K tokens). Merged branches are marked '(merged into main)' and become project knowledge. _(why: Default to the most recent work on the branch; easy to override. Feature knowledge becomes shared after merge.)_ · `plugin/src/pack.mjs:140, plugin/src/store.mjs:89, ## Sessions@docs/FAQ.md:72` `m-54e9f2`

## Lessons
- **Test hang at 28min: unclosed HTTP server kept test process alive forever**: Full test suite (~2min runtime) was hanging for 28+ minutes. Cause: a failed dashboard API test didn't close its local HTTP server (startViewer returned server with no cleanup path). Process never exited; test command timed out. Fix: ensure all servers close in finally blocks. After fix: suite runs 2 min, all 34 tests pass. _(why: Test infrastructure bug masked by silent output filter. Root cause: server setup without matching teardown.)_ · `test('dashboard API@test/core.test.mjs:650` `m-8f51a1`
- **Host injections not user prompts: <task-notification>, <agent-message>, <system-reminder> are notices, not control targets**: When the host (Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor, etc.) injects `<task-notification>`, `<agent-message>`, or `<system-reminder>`-only lines as turns in the conversation, UAC records them as short `notice` events, not user prompts. They do not trigger `uac:` control parsing (subagent reports carry no user authority), do not set session title or goal, and do not fire `uac_propose` checklist. The full subagent result comes via `SubagentStop` event. Compaction summaries are similarly skipped. Fix prevents miscounting events and incorrect checkpoints from harness messages. · `SessionStart@plugin/src/hook.mjs:25` `m-86ee04`

## Warnings
- **Cascade delete: session removal also deletes events, card, created memories**: Deleting a session removes: its events, its card (summaries + checkpoints), its retrieval logs, and memories this session created. Deletion is confirmed by dashboard two-step button UI (avoids VS Code confirm() bug which always returns false). Empty sessions older than 30 min eligible for cleanup. _(why: Old delete used browser confirm() which always fails in VS Code. Two-step button UI works. Cascade prevents orphaned data fragments.)_ · `## Sessions@docs/FAQ.md:89, plugin/src/view.mjs` `m-c9d40f`
- **PC sleep pauses background work; screen off is OK**: Screen off (display timeout): ✅ work continues. Screen lock (Win+L): ✅ work continues. PC sleep or hibernate: ❌ pauses everything (tests, sessions) until wake. Closing VS Code or Claude Code: ❌ stops session. Check Windows sleep settings; 30-min screen off is fine. _(why: User asked if locked screen allows background work. Important for long test runs overnight.)_ `m-a30c99`

## Ideas (not facts)
- **Inter-agent communication: UAC messages vs SendMessage**: UAC messages (#uac msg to branch:feature/theme ...) cross tools and branches (Codex ↔ Claude, main ↔ feature). SendMessage is same-tool only. UAC messages reach other session at next prompt, once. Use case: 'I renamed getUser → fetchUser'. Question: does same-tool agent-to-agent need UAC messages, or is SendMessage sufficient? (Decided: SendMessage covers same-tool; UAC messages matter across-tool.) _(why: User asked if inter-agent comm via UAC is needed. Yes for cross-tool/branch; SendMessage already covers same-tool.)_ · `Can agents talk to each other@docs/FAQ.md:166` `m-8188f0`
